claim: IniConfig is a class that parses INI files and provides methods to access configuration values and their line numbers.
factuality_explanation: The historical source code shows that IniConfig is initialized with a file path and optionally data. It reads the file or uses provided data to parse lines using a function `_parse.parse_lines`. The parsed tokens include line numbers, section headers, names, and values. The class has methods `items` to iterate over configuration items and appears to store sources (line numbers) associated with each item.
